D6's notes 4 and 5, on its Article 2 page: one side of a new building must have a 0 ft side setback (note 4, checked by a later guide question), and the Planning Board may increase the side setback for access to the rear of the lot, but not beyond 15 ft (note 5). So 0-5 ft fits, over 5 up to 15 ft is the Board's decision, over 15 ft is outside. Coverage memo Q15; DECISIONS-NEEDED D-0004.
